_comment: Merge this PreToolUse entry into each bot's ~/.claude/settings.json (under .hooks.PreToolUse). It runs block-nested-claude.py before every Bash call and blocks a non-isolated nested `claude`. NOTE: settings.json is AgentShield-protected, so this must be applied by the operator, not self-written by the bot. install path assumed: /usr/local/share/claude-guard/block-nested-claude.py
